intro: Reading the Ley Lines is a rite of passage for young Skyborne discovering their Highborne magical heritage. Entrusted by Falorne Fallwind on Zephras Isle, novitiates travel to the standing stones in Thendal Grove to sense and draw upon the raw arcane currents surging through the elemental terrain.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Here in the elemental plane, we derive much of our arcane strength from leylines that still run through the ground under our feet. Of late, these leylines have begun to pierce the surface, giving us more direct and powerful access to these latent arcane energies.
Go to the standing stones to the northeast. There is a leyline there. Tap into your birthright and draw in its energy.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Realizing our true potential as sons and daughters of the highborne is our only path to salvation. The Windshapers are little better than the Al'Aketh, supplicating themselves to uncaring, otherworldly creatures.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Do you feel it? Yes? Good! You have taken your first steps. You'll find that with your abilities, you will be able to tap into latent magical energy in many locations. Doing so will provide a myriad of benefits, some profound, others more subtle. You won't know until you tap into them, but that's the best part of the gift... Making the unknown known.
If we are to survive these dire times, we must be unwavering in our search for knowledge... And power.
